title: A manual querylog.py apply --push records its outcome in distill.log, so land's undelivered warning names its failed gate
goal: querylog.py apply --push run by hand (querylog.py:264, out=print) writes its apply --push lines and gate lines to the store's distill.log as the automatic push (ql_distill.py:833) does, so bl_land.last_push_failure names the last run's failed gate, not an older automatic run's or nothing

clauses.clause: querylog.py apply --push run by hand (querylog.py:264, out=print) writes its apply --push lines and gate lines to the store's distill.log as the automatic push (ql_distill.py:833) does, so bl_land.last_push_failure names the last run's failed gate, not an older automatic run's or nothing

notes: Found at the SP-kwi4ilty review. Premise run 2026-10-12: ql_deliver.push's out defaults to print, querylog.py:264 calls ql_deliver.push() with it, and ql_deliver.py names neither distill.log nor ql_distill.LOG_NAME, so only the automatic push (its stdout detached into distill.log, ql_distill.py:833) leaves lines for bl_land.last_push_failure. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 16 of 19, "Land snags: gate answers committed by the tool, link touches, stale-touch reads, generated coverage files and the undelivered warning"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
